name: arXiv:2507.00418 — Serving LLMs in HPC Clusters: QAic 100 Ultra vs A100/V100/A6000/H200/MI300A (vLLM)
notes: PEARC'25 paper. vLLM serving benchmark on NRP. Table 2 = peak aggregate tok/s per accelerator per model; concurrency swept 32-256 concurrent requests, best card-count config chosen per cell. QAic = Cloud AI 100 Ultra (maps to accelerator qualcomm-ai200, 128GB, 4 SoC/card). AGGREGATE multi-request throughput, NOT per-request decode. MI300A used where a model fit (128GB APU).
